headlines.title: Stock market today: S&P 500, Nasdaq futures rise as earnings roll in, SpaceX stock surges
headlines.summary: Investors assessed a batch of earnings on Wednesday as SpaceX shares surged.

headlines.title: Netflix co-CEO Ted Sarandos reveals two problems that have nothing to do with YouTube dominance and that don't have easy fixes
headlines.summary: Netflix has several key challenges that won't be fixed overnight.

headlines.title: The massive risk hiding inside your S&P 500 index fund
headlines.summary: The Bahnsen Group Chief Investment Officer David Bahnsen and Roundhill Investments Chief Investment Strategist Drew Pettit discuss the hidden dangers of top-heavy passive index funds.

headlines.title: ISRG, NFLX, ACN Stocks Slide Before The Bell: Why Intuitive Surgical, Netflix And Accenture Are Heading Lower
headlines.summary: A $450-million litigation charge weighs on Intuitive Surgical, while Netflix faces fresh concerns over growth visibility and Baird turns cautious on Accenture.

headlines.title: No Breakout Hit and an Ad Shortfall: What Netflix Needs to Prove Next
headlines.summary: Netflix beat on profits but Wall Street is calling it a "show me" story, pointing to a missing global hit, a stumbling ad rollout, and slowing revenue growth as three tests the streamer must pass before January.

description: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services worldwide. The company offers television (TV) series, documentaries, feature films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages. It also provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, TV set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Netflix, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.
